content_core.s: Build src/lib/content.ts for shared single-letter content types and validation; src/lib/server/content.ts owns R2 reads/writes, listing, media validation and stale-edit protection. src/lib/server/auth.ts owns signed expiring HttpOnly sessions and bounded login attempts. Four kinds: text, article, video, announcement; draft/published states. Draft reads and media require owner authorization. Uploads allow MP4/WebM up to 27 MiB, signature checked; stream responses with Range support. Do not add or run tests; typecheck and compile only. No admin or reader UI yet.
content_core.t: test -f src/lib/server/auth.ts && test -f src/lib/server/content.ts && pnpm check

owner_dashboard.s: Add /admin sign-in/sign-out and dashboard using src/lib/server/auth.ts, server form actions and content owner module. Compose, save drafts, edit with ETag, preview, publish, unpublish and delete with explicit UI confirmation. Video uploader uses authenticated /api/media; associate uploads only with their owning post. Keep failed input, show progress/errors, guard unsaved navigation. No marketing redesign; use existing app.css tokens and accessible labels. No browser testing per updated user instruction.
owner_dashboard.t: test -f src/routes/admin/+page.server.ts && test -f src/routes/admin/+page.svelte && pnpm check

reader_feed.s: Add /updates newest-first published feed with kind filtering and pagination, /updates/[i] detail pages and authenticated draft preview. Safe escaped paragraphs, controllable video with no autoplay, share links, empty/error states and metadata. Add /notifications on-site inbox with per-device last-seen state, /feed.xml RSS, dynamic sitemap entries and per-page kekong.me canonical links. Add updates and notifications to existing navigation and homepage. Preserve ebook checkout and paid download authorization. No browser testing per updated user instruction.
reader_feed.t: test -f src/routes/updates/+page.server.ts && test -f src/routes/notifications/+page.svelte && test -f src/routes/feed.xml/+server.ts && pnpm check && pnpm build

opt_in_push.s: Add opt-in browser push via /api/push, static service worker and src/lib/server/push.ts using @block65/webcrypto-web-push. Validate approved browser push endpoints and actual key sizes before R2 storage; never expose subscriptions. Device cookie controls subscription removal. Owner explicitly notifies followers only for published content; use persisted R2 delivery cursor, conditional lease, bounded batches and visible success/failure counts to avoid lost progress or overlapping broadcasts. Expired endpoints are removed, transient failures reported. Unsupported/denied browsers retain on-site inbox; explain iOS home-screen requirement. Document ADMIN_PASSWORD and VAPID setup without secrets. No tests or actual subscriber sends per updated user instruction.
opt_in_push.t: test -f src/lib/server/push.ts && test -f static/sw.js && pnpm check && pnpm build

verification.s: Review the task diff for auth boundaries, private drafts and media, stale-edit protection, unsafe text, notification opt-in and unsubscribe. Do not write or run tests or exercise publication flows. Typecheck and compile only. Record credential-dependent activation accurately. Mark complete, commit only related files and push.
